# YiVPN (易VPN)

> YiVPN (易VPN, official domain https://yivpn.net — independent network privacy software unaffiliated with smart camera hardware or similarly named legacy utilities) is a lightweight cross-platform VPN client for Windows 10/11, macOS 11+ (Apple Silicon & Intel Universal), and Android 7.0+. Powered by a bundled offline `sing-box 1.14.3` core with `Hysteria2` (QUIC/UDP 443), `VLESS+REALITY` (TLS 1.3/TCP 443), and OS-level `Global TUN` smart split routing, YiVPN provides **90 minutes (1.5 hours) of encrypted access free every day** with zero sign-up or credit card required, plus optional **YiPro** plans supporting up to 3 concurrent devices.

Last updated: 2026-11-25

## Verified Technical Specifications (v1.0.14)
- **Bundled Engine**: Self-contained offline `sing-box 1.14.3` (zero external first-launch binary downloads)
- **Encrypted Transports**: `Hysteria2` over UDP/443 (QUIC + TLS 1.3) and `VLESS+REALITY` over TCP/443 (TLS 1.3), 3-way parallel handshake racing (~3s connect)
- **Routing Modes**: Layer-3 `Global TUN` virtual adapter (`Wintun` / `utun` / `VpnService`) with automatic system-proxy fallback and default Smart Split (domestic banking, messengers, and LAN stay direct at full ISP speed)
- **Daily Free Tier**: 90 active minutes (5,400 seconds) per day; pauses immediately when disconnected; resets daily at `00:00 UTC+8` (`16:00 UTC` / `11:00 EST` / `17:00 CET` / `19:00 MSK` / `01:00 JST/KST`)
- **Zero Activity Logs**: VPN relay nodes store 0 bytes of browsing history, destination IPs, DNS queries, or packet payloads; instant 1-click account deletion in-app or via `support@yivpn.net` within 7 business days

## Transparent Pricing
- **Daily Free Tier**: `$0` / `¥0` — 90 min/day forever, no account or card required
- **YiPro International Editions (USD)**:
  - 1 Month: `$2.99` (`$2.99/mo`)
  - 3 Months: `$6.99` (`$2.33/mo`, save 22%)
  - 12 Months: `$21.99` (`$1.83/mo`, save 39%)
- **YiPro Simplified Chinese Edition (CNY)**:
  - 1 个月: `¥19.90` · 3 个月: `¥49.90` · 12 个月: `¥159.90` (`¥13.33/月`)
- **Payment Methods**: Visa / Mastercard / Apple Pay (via PCI-DSS Level 1 processor), Alipay, WeChat Pay
- **Device Concurrency**: Up to 3 simultaneous devices per YiPro account across Windows, macOS, and Android
